fact: The UNDP consultant notice (e-government project) states that communal tax collection was a manual perception system, that the Ministry of the Interior's Direction des Finances Communales planned to acquire an IT solution to replace it, and calls for a survey of the system across the 119 communes.
title: Recrutement de deux consultants nationaux chargés de mener une étude de faisabilité pour la modernisation, la rationalisation et la sécurisation de la gestion des taxes communales au Burundi
